questions.question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.**

Aphrodite vowed that Paris __would had__ the most beautiful woman as his wife.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "**would have**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence the usage of the auxiliary verb "had" after the modal verb would is incorrect.
 
• We commonly use the "would have" as it is the** conditional perfect.**
 
• We use the modal auxiliary **would have** to refer to a situation to express a missed opportunity in the past.

**The correct sentence is**: *Aphrodite vowed that Paris would have__** the most beautiful woman as his wife*.

Hence, the correct answer is** option 2**.

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

He ______ an important question in the meeting.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "**raised**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the **meaning** of the given words.

 
 
• **Rose**: a garden plant with thorns on its stems and pleasant-smelling flowers, or a flower from this plant
 
• **Risen**: move from a lower position to a higher one; come or go up.
 
• **Rise**: get up from lying, sitting, or kneeling.
 
• **Raised**: to elevate something to a higher level/position.
 
 
 
• **​'Rose' **is also the past tense of the word rise.
 
• **"Risen"** is the past participle of the word rise.
 
• The word** rise** and **raise** have similar meanings but there is one functional difference.
 
• Rise is an **intransitive **verb and raise is a **transitive **verb.
 
• **Intransitive verbs **don't require an object to complete meaning while transitive verbs do.
 
 
• **Example**: *The smoke **rises **__from the fores*t(intransitive)
 
• *He __**raised **__his hand to answer the question*(transitive)
 
 
 
• In the given sentence the phrase **"raised a question"** means to start talking about a subject that you want other people to consider.

**​The correct sentence is:*** **He __**raised **__an important question in the meeting.*

​Hence, the correct answer is** option 4.**
